method: Self-authored QualifyNativeEmbedding run explicitly through native Macro dialog. Creates a separate workbook, inserts owned embedded-source.xlsx via OLEObjects.Add, saves plain XLS and CryptoAPI password-to-open XLS. Native output workbook has no macro project. No application security settings changed.

encryptionProfile.encryptedEntries: one embedding storage; no document-property descriptors
encryptionProfile.nativeMirror: same class/state and stream bytes outside encrypted container; root timestamps differ

limits: Native-producer encrypted document properties are not qualified by this cohort. The explicit-provider option call returned error 5; the properties-only attempt also saved plaintext property streams.
This qualifies an embedded XLSX package, not arbitrary OLE activation, links, ActiveX or every embedded server.
Stored marker and successful native SaveAs prove execution of the self-authored controller only.
